violation_type.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation's name and telephone number must be clearly visible on the outside of the vehicle or kept inside the vehicle.

finding_variants.text: The operation's name and telephone number must be clearly visible on the outside of the vehicle or kept inside the vehicle.
